tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /gsang bdag 'byung po 'dul byed kyi rjes gnang gi bla ma brgyud pa la gsol ba 'debs pa'i rab tu byed pa bzhugs so// na mo gu ra we/ rgyal ba kun dngos khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang / /gsang ba'i bdag po ye shes mkha' 'gro ma dri med gzi brjid/ /mya ngan med rdo rje gdan pa gnyis kyi che ba dpal don yod rdo rje chung ba la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag brgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /rin chen grags dang brtse chen snying po'i zhabs/ /rje btsun grags pa mchim ston chos kyi seṅge dang / /'jam gsar shes rab 'od zer rnam rgyal rdo rje rong pa rga la la/ /gsol ba 'debs so༞ /rga lo'i sras shes rab seng ge gzhon nu bag ston tshul khrims zhabs/ /tshul khrims rgya mtshan dpal ldan tshul khrims dang / /ye shes rgya mtshan kun dga' bzang po la/ /gsol ba 'debs so༞ /kun dga' dbang phyug yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel/ /lha mchog seng ge bud+dha sing ha dang / /nam mkha' dpal bzang rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag brgyad byin gyis rlobs/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma'i tshogs la gsol 'debs kyis/ /mkhyen brtse nus pa chen pos legs gzigs nas/ /mtha' yas 'gro ba kun gyi don bsgrub phyir/ /bdag gi smon smon lam mdor bstan lam 'grub par byin gyis rlabs/ /sngon 'gro'i chos kyis bdag brgyud legs sbyangs nas/ /srung 'khor dbus su pad zlar hūm̐ yig gis/ /'phro 'du las grub gsang ba'i bdag po yi/ /rnal 'byor bsgom la gegs med mthar phyin shog /mthar thug gi 'bras gsang ba gsum las sku'i gsang ba sku mchog bsgom pas phan bde 'byung ba'i gnas/ /bsam gyis mi khyab sku yi gsang ba mchog /bdag gis thob nas 'khor ba'i mthar thug par/ /sna tshogs sprul pas 'gro ba'i don byed shog /gsung gi gsang ba gsung mchog bzlas pas don chen 'grub pa'i rgyu/

/bsam gyis mi khyab gsung gi gsang ba mchog /bdag gis thob nas mkha' mnyam sems can la/ /rang rang skad kyis dam chos ston par shog /thugs kyi gsang ba thugs mchog bsgom pas srid zhi'i mtha' spangs pa/ /bsam gyis mi khyab thugs kyi gsang ba mchog /bdag gis thob nas 'gro ba ma lus pa'i/ /sems brgyud ye shes mchog tu bsgyur bar shog /de lta'i gsung gsum bsgom pa'i gnas gnas skabs kyi 'bras bu skabs su/ /nyams thag gzhan gyi nad gdon bar chad rnams/ /bdag gis mthong thos reg pas kun zhi nas/ /gnod bya gnod byed bde la sbyor bar shog /mdor na bdag gi las nyon dri ma'i tshogs/ /thams cad dag nas gsang ba'i bdag po'i zhal/ /mngon sum mthong nas lus rten 'di nyid la/ /zung 'jug rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa thob shog /ces don dran bzhin pas gsol ba gdab par bya'o/ /de ltar gsol ba 'debs pa'i yul gyi bla ma 'di rnams ni bcom ldan 'das gsang ba'i bdag po'i rjes gnang gi brgyud pa thun mong ma yin pa'o/ /thun mong ba ni sgrub thabs rgya mtsho'i brgyud pa ltar yin no/ /zhes pa 'di ni yi dam 'di la mos shing / sgrub pa la brtson pa'i rnal 'byor pa shes rab dpal ldan gyis bskul ba'i ngor/ dpal ldan don grub kyis e waṃ chos 'khor rtser sbyar ba'o/ /maṅga laṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 ngor mkhan po dpal ldan don grub/ 'byung 'dul rjes gnang gi bla brgyud gsol 'debs/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
